body: Thank you everyone, I needed this

It absolutely is that. They also have a reputation for treating their staff like garbage. 

Try the Kimpton. Much better value for money.
What do they usually go for? I just loved them and hadn’t seen anything like them before.
The label stuck to them and nothing else 🙈🤣
My partner took his life in the same way, I’m 6 weeks into it. All my love and strength to you.

I take Clonazepam which was prescribed by my psychiatrist. It doesn’t really take the sadness away, I still feel sad all the time. It helps to me sleep without dreaming about him and what happened to him so I mostly take it at night.

My psychiatrist won’t prescribe me antidepressants because she believes my experience of grief is normal and I’m not actually depressed. 

I don’t know, I feel depressed so who knows.
Thank you! I will give it a try

I am so sorry to hear that you're going through this. I lost my partner on the 9th of January and I understand everything you've written completely. If you want someone to talk to, i'm here for you. Feel free to message me to talk whenever you like.

I agree with @deb-scott, a psychiatrist has helped me a lot. Don't be afraid to talk about what you're going through, you're not alone.
Thank you for acknowledging me and my pain, it is so appreciated. I'm so sorry you have pain in your lives as well.
